body: Thailand’s Industry Ministry invoked Section 39 of the Factory Act 1992 to suspend all four refining units at Bangchak’s Phra Khanong refinery pending comprehensive safety inspections, leaving the facility fully shut after the fire. [E4]
Thailand’s government said Bangchak’s preliminary findings place the fire in the hydrocracking unit and that the company is investigating its cause while assessing equipment damage. [E1]

The refinery will not be allowed to reopen until officials are fully confident that the cause is confirmed, the fire cannot spread to tanks, storage systems are safe and the incident cannot recur, the minister said. [E2]
The government said benzene measurements at six sites ranged from 0.01 to 0.32 ppm, below its 52-ppm reference level for 60-minute exposure. [E3]
